Nova AI Workspace - RAG Test Document
This PDF is intentionally text-based so you can test PDF upload, extraction, chunking, retrieval,
and question answering in your Nova project.
Project Overview
Nova AI Workspace is a personal artificial intelligence platform built with FastAPI, React, and
Ollama. Its purpose is to provide a private and customizable assistant for conversations, coding
support, document analysis, and future automation workflows.
The backend exposes API endpoints for normal chat, streamed responses, conversation deletion,
and PDF document upload. The frontend provides persistent chat history, smooth streaming, a
stop-generation button, and a document attachment interface.
Current Features
Feature
Description
Local AI model
Nova communicates with an Ollama model running on the local machine.
Streaming responses
Text appears gradually in the interface while the backend is generating it.
Stop generation
The user can cancel a response while it is still being produced.
Conversation memory
Each chat has its own conversation identifier and stored history.
PDF upload
The backend accepts text-based PDF files and extracts readable text page by page.
RAG Test Facts
Use the following facts to test whether Nova can retrieve information from this document:
 The internal test codename for this document is Project Ember.
 The fictional launch date is 18 October 2026.
 The preferred accent color is copper orange.
 The maximum PDF upload size in the current prototype is 15 MB.
 The planned next milestone is semantic search with embeddings and source references.
Suggested Questions
 What is the internal test codename?
 What fictional launch date is mentioned?
 What is the current PDF upload limit?
 Which technologies are used to build Nova?
 What is the next planned milestone?
